sanskrit: niḥsālāṃ dhṛṣṇuṃ dhiṣaṇam ekāvādyāṃ jighatsvam | sarvāś caṇḍasya naptyo nāśayāmaḥ sadānvāḥ ||
english: The houseless, the bold, the clever one, the solitary-speaker, the devouring one — we destroy all the granddaughters of Caṇḍa, the perpetually pursuing ones (sadānvāḥ).

sanskrit: yadi vā gha kṣetriyād yadi vā puruṣeṣitāḥ | yadi stha dasyubhyo jātā naśyatetaḥ sadānvāḥ ||
english: Whether you have arisen from hereditary disease (kṣetriya), or whether you have been sent by a man, or whether you were born from the Dasyus — perish hence, O perpetually pursuing ones (sadānvāḥ)!

sanskrit: pari dhāmāny āsām āśur gāṣṭhām ivāsaram | ajaiṣaṃ sarvām̐ ājīn vo naśyatetaḥ sadānvāḥ ||
english: I have swiftly encircled their abodes, as one drives cattle to the pen. I have conquered all your contests — perish hence, O perpetually pursuing ones!

sanskrit: nir vo goṣṭhād ajāmasi nir yoner nir upānasāt | nir vo magundyā duhitaro gṛhebhyaś cātayāmasi ||
english: We drive you out from the cow-pen, out from the womb, out from the cart; we chase you away, O daughters of Magundī, from the houses.

sanskrit: amuṣminn adhare gṛhe sarvāḥ santv arāyyaḥ | tatra pāpmā ny ucyatu sarvāś ca yātudhānyaḥ ||
english: In that lower house over there, let all the miserly demons (arāyyaḥ) dwell; let sin be poured out there, and all the sorcerer-women (yātudhānyaḥ) as well.

sanskrit: dyāvāpṛthivī urv antarikṣaṃ kṣetrasya patny urugāyo adbhutaḥ | utāntarikṣam uru vātagopaṃ te gha tapyantāṃ mayi tapyamāne ||
english: Heaven and Earth, the broad mid-space, the mistress of the field, the wide-ranging, wondrous one — and the broad atmosphere guarded by the wind — let these all burn with affliction for me, even as I am burning.

sanskrit: idam indra śṛṇuhi somapa yat tvā hṛdā śocatā johavīmi | vṛścāmi taṃ kuliśeneva vṛkṣaṃ yo asmākaṃ mana idaṃ hinasti ||
english: Hear this, O Indra, drinker of Soma — I call upon you repeatedly with a burning heart: I shall hew down like a tree with an axe him who harms this mind of ours.

sanskrit: idaṃ devāḥ śṛṇuta ye ca yajñiyā stha bharadvājo mahyam ukthāni śaṃsatu | pāśe sa baddho durite ni yujyatāṃ yo asmākaṃ mana idaṃ hinasti ||
english: Hear this, O Gods, you who are worthy of sacrifice — let Bharadvāja recite the praises for me: let him who harms this mind of ours be bound in a snare and fastened into misfortune.

sanskrit: aśītibhis tisṛbhiḥ sāmagebhir ādityebhir vasubhir aṅgirobhiḥ | iṣṭāpūrtam avatu naḥ pitṝṇām āmuṃ dade harasā daivyena ||
english: With the eighty-three chanters of Sāmans, with the Ādityās, the Vasus, and the Aṅgirases, may the merit of our fathers' sacrificial offerings and pious works protect us — I seize that man with divine consuming fire.

sanskrit: dyāvāpṛthivī anu mā dīdhīthāṃ viśve devāso anu mā rabhadhvam | aṅgirasaḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ pāpam ā rcchatv apakāmasya kartā ||
english: May Heaven and Earth shine after me; may all the Gods take hold of me. May the Aṅgirasas, the Soma-drinking ancestral fathers, let evil befall him who is the author of malicious will.

sanskrit: atīva yo maruto manyate no brahma vā yo nindiṣat kriyamāṇam | tapūṃṣi tasmai vṛjināni santu brahmadviṣam abhi taṃ śocatu dyauḥ ||
english: He who thinks too little of our sacred word, O Maruts, or who would revile the brahman being performed — let burning afflictions and crooked evils be his lot; let the sky burn down upon that hater of the brahman.

sanskrit: ā dadhāmi te padaṃ samiddhe jātavedasi | agniḥ śarīraṃ veveṣṭu yamaṃ gacchatu te asuḥ ||
english: I lay your footstep upon the kindled Jātavedas (Fire who knows all beings); may Agni envelope your body; may your life-breath go to Yama.

sanskrit: sapta prāṇān aṣṭau majjñas tāṃs te vṛścāmi brahmaṇā | yamasya gaccha sādanam agnidūto araṃkṛtaḥ ||
english: The seven breaths and the eight marrows — these I hew asunder from you by the sacred word. Go to the dwelling of Yama, made ready as the messenger of Agni.

sanskrit: venas tat paśyat paramaṃ padaṃ yatra viśvaṃ bhavaty ekanīḍam | idaṃ dhenur aduhaj jāyamānāḥ svarvido abhy anūṣata vrāḥ ||
english: The seer (Vena) beheld that supreme footstep where the All becomes a single nest. There the milch-cow yielded forth this — the hosts who know the heavenly world sang after, as it was being born.

sanskrit: pra tad voced amṛtaṃ na vidvān gandharvo dhāma paramaṃ guhā yat | trīṇi padā nihitā guhāsya yas tāni veda sa pituṣ pitāsat ||
english: The Gandharva, though not knowing the immortal, proclaimed that supreme abode which lies concealed in the cave. Three footsteps are set down in the secret place; he who knows them becomes the father of the father.

sanskrit: sa no bandhur janitā sa vidhartā dhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā | yatra devā amṛtam ānaśānāḥ samāne dhāmann adhy airayanta ||
english: He is our kinsman, he is the progenitor, he is the sustainer; he knows all the abodes, all the worlds. There where the Gods, having reached immortality, were set in motion in the common dwelling.

sanskrit: pari viśvā bhuvanāny āyam upātiṣṭhe prathamajā ṛtasya | vācam iva vaktari bhuvaneṣṭhā dhāsyur nv eṣa nanv eṣo agniḥ ||
english: I have come around all the worlds; I stand attendant upon the first-born of cosmic order (ṛta). Like speech in a speaker, he who dwells in the worlds and is the nourisher — verily, this is Agni.

sanskrit: pari dyāvāpṛthivī sadya āyam ṛtasya tantuṃ vitataṃ dṛśe kam | devo devatvam abhirakṣamāṇaḥ samānaṃ bandhuṃ vy apṛcchad ekaḥ ||
english: I have come around Heaven and Earth straightway, to behold the stretched-out thread of cosmic order (ṛta). The god, guarding his divine nature, the One asked after the common bond.
